pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway (prod-usw2) error-rate spike (5xx) — incident P-12345 — page fired
amelia (oncall): acked. i'm on it. starting triage.
jonas: +1 — passing to night shift. any obvious customer reports yet?
ellie (cs): i have a ticket from ACME complaining about failed generations since 00:42 UTC. they reported a 502 on our API.
sre-runbook-bot: runbook: inference-gateway-5xx -> steps: check-kv-cache, check-upstream, verify-deploys. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
amelia (oncall): first quick checks: metrics dashboard shows 5xx rate went from ~0.2% -> 9% at 00:41 UTC, p50 latency up 2x. affected region prod-usw2 only.
miguel: logs from edge show lots of 502 gateway responses with "kvcache-miss" and "backend-unavailable". sampling below:
```
[00:41:12] inference-gateway us-west2 edge.go:401 warn response=502 err="kv cache eviction: shard-unavailable"
[00:41:13] model-connector.go:210 error upstream connection refused
```
tara: deployment? any recent rollouts to west?
jonas: no deploys in last 6h. infra autoscaler did a small scale event at 00:20 but nothing unusual.
amelia (oncall): running quick curl test against the public API to replicate:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'
```
result: intermittent 502/504. sometimes 200.
opsbot: Auto-remediation attempted: increased gw-pool replicas by 20% at 00:45 UTC (reason: trafficsurge).
miguel: curious — kvcache eviction logs spike at same time as error-rate. could be KV service flapping and causing downstream 5xx.
amelia (oncall): next: check kv service health and tail kube events for kv pods.
sre-runbook-bot: suggested command: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=kvstore -o wide`
jonas: i can run that, giving me 2m.
jonas: kvstore pods: 3/3 Running but restartCount for kv-2 is 7 in last 30m. kube events show OOMKilled at 00:40 for kv-2 then restart.
miguel: OOM -> eviction -> gateway cache misses -> more load on origin -> 502s. plausible.
amelia (oncall): mitigation options: 1) restart kv pod(s) gracefully, 2) increase kvstore memory, 3) route a % of traffic to eu-west until kv stabilized, 4) enable degraded-mode fallback to cached responses.
tara: rolling restart kv-2 now? Might cause a brief disruption but it's already flapping.
jonas: recommend gracefully cordon kv-2, let leader election settle, then restart. doing that now: `kubectl drain kv-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
jonas: drain succeeded, restarting kv-2.
```bash
kubectl rollout restart statefulset/kvstore -n infra
```
opsbot: note: autoscaler scale event rolled back after restart attempt.
amelia (oncall): while that restarts, i'm going to shift 25% of inference traffic in prod-usw2 -> prod-eu-west via routing-slice to reduce pressure on kv. executing ramp: `trafficctl route --from=prod-usw2 --to=prod-eu-west --percent=25 --scope=inference`
miguel: nice. also bumping gateway pool to +1 replica just to smooth connections.
ellie (cs): i've informed ACME CRO that we're investigating and reducing load to mitigate outages. asked for exact timestamps and examples.
amelia (oncall): monitoring: after kv restart and routing change error-rate dropped to ~1.4% within 3 minutes. p95 latency improving.
jonas: good signal. keep watch for flapping restarts. check memory metrics on kv-2 to see why OOM.
miguel: memory usage climbed steadily over last hour — looks like a memory leak in kv-connector during heavy prefix-cache churn. opening a ticket for devs.
amelia (oncall): creating incident page summary and assigning follow-up: P-12345 -> Sev2, owners: miguel (kv), tara (gateway), jonas (oncall follow).
sre-runbook-bot: recommended post-incident actions: add OOM alert to kvstore, set pod-memory request to +20%, add rate-limiting on gateway to smooth bursts.
amelia (oncall): will file runbook updates. cs: update ACME with ETA for root cause and mitigation steps.
ellie (cs): updated customer. they asked about SLA credit — i'll open a support case, will sync with eng after RCA.
opsbot: note: automated PD escalation suppressed at 00:57 after ack and mitigation applied.
amelia (oncall): final checks: run synthetic load test to validate recovery.
```bash
# quick smoke to validate 200 responses
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' | jq '.status'; done
```
jonas: all smoke tests returned 200.
amelia (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. moving to postmortem. tagging owners. :white_check_mark:
miguel: creating bug for kv-connector memory leak, will include heap dumps.
tara: will follow up on autoscaler tuning and gateway rate-limiting.
ellie (cs): i'll keep ACME updated and track support case.
pagerbot: Incident P-12345 status: Mitigated -> followup tasks created.
amelia (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in the incident doc and handoff to daytime oncall. handoff @jonas — please continue watch for 2 hours.
jonas: copying. will monitor dashboards and escalate if errors rise above 2% again.
amelia (oncall): end thread — moving to postmortem channel once root cause confirmed. :coffee:
